column1: # RE-MEASUREMENT OF THE ELEVEN UNCORROBORATED win32-x64 FULL-DISK ROWS.
# `fullDisk` is the widest grant the catalog has, and on Windows it is wider still than on
# the other two platforms: it launches the script WITHOUT the LowBox token, and egress is an
# AppContainer capability, so declining the token concedes the network with it. Eleven live
# entries reached that rung without clearing the corroboration guard in apply-matrix.mjs,
# and five of them failed on `Could not find any Python installation to use` — a
# toolchain-shaped string, which is the exact class that already produced two false
# NEEDS-FULL-DISK rows on a linux-x64 host whose node was symlinked out of the granted
# prefix. Re-measure them on a host that has PROVED it carries the toolchain.
# THE FIRST THREE ROWS ARE THE POSITIVE CONTROL AND THEY ARE PINNED.
# Each is a bare node-gyp compile committed as NEEDS-NOTHING on win32-x64, so each already
# demonstrates that node-gyp can find Python and MSVC from INSIDE the jail with no grants at
# all — the one question `--toolchain-proof` cannot answer, since it necessarily probes from
# outside. If any of them fails its `no_grants` cell, the host is wrong and NO verdict from
# the run may be published. They lead the file so that with three slots each slot takes one
# first, and a slot that dies part-way still carries its own control.
# Versions are pinned for the controls, because a control whose meaning drifts with a new
# release is not a control. The eleven stay at `latest`, which is what they were measured at.
